description: A broad articulated task-light search fan is drawn with open geometric rays, stepped floor illumination tiles and a rectangular scan gate. The bright source remains the lamp face; no glow textures, transparency or dynamic lighting are required.
toggle_contract: Set this subtree visible/invisible in the target engine. Geometry has no autonomous playback; caller controls visibility and any motion.

fx_search_sweep.note: Rigid articulation, artistic guide; not a collision guarantee.
